purpose: Retrospective hand-curated source cases. Does an article merit further winter-layup evidence review? This does not label confirmed arrivals or estimate future model accuracy.
caseSelection: Known source-backed winter records plus observed nonlayup feed headlines; selected rather than random. Off-season and routine traffic negatives were reviewed from dates/titles. No user submissions.
